We need to produce a tool call. Let's try to extract product SMILES more accurately. The mapped product: [F:1][CH:2]1[CH2:3][N:4]([CH2:5][c:6]2[cH:7][cH:8][cH:9][cH:10][cH:11]2)[CH2:12]1

Remove mapping brackets: FCH1CH2N(CH2c2ccccc2)CH2C1? Actually need proper SMILES: start with F attached to carbon (CH) which is part of a ring labeled 1. So carbon 2 is CH (sp3) with F attached. Then that carbon is part of a ring: ...1 ...1 closure. So the ring is: [CH]1[CH2][N(... )][CH2]1. That's a four-membered ring (azetidine) with a fluoromethyl? Actually carbon bearing F is part of ring. So SMILES: 'FC1CH2N(CH2c2ccccc2)CH2C1'. That seems plausible.

Now call apply_template with molecule_smiles that string and template_id "1914395".
